translations.web: “ ‘ “Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’
translations.bsb: Behold, all who speak in proverbs will quote this proverb about you: ‘Like mother, like daughter.’
translations.kjv: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
